Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.port.outbound

Interface NewsletterAutoSendPort

All Known Implementing Classes:
NewsletterAutoSendAdapter
public interface NewsletterAutoSendPort
Outbound port for managing the newsletter auto-send override setting.

By default, the daily newsletter scheduler auto-sends after generating a draft. When the override is active for a given date, auto-send is suppressed and the draft must be sent manually via the Newsletter Preview UI.
